description: This document outlines the terms and conditions of TATA AIG Travel Insurance - International Plus Health, providing comprehensive coverage for various risks and uncertainties during international travel, including medical expenses, emergency medical evacuation, repatriation of remains, accidental death and disablement, emergency medical dental expenses, delay of checked-in baggage, loss of checked-in baggage, loss of passport, and other related conditions and exclusions.
